en: A multi-view postcard showing several religious buildings and interiors around the city of Pécs. The upper left view is a small historic church in a rural setting. The upper right view shows a city square with a prominent domed former mosque (now a church) surrounded by older buildings and parked cars from the socialist era. The central image depicts the interior of a traditional church with a Baroque-style altar. The bottom left view shows a modern white church with angular, minimalist architecture, while the bottom right view shows the interior of this modern church, including a white balcony decorated with abstract reliefs and a simple altar. The reverse side has standard postcard address lines and Hungarian-language publishing information.
